description: This Java class 'ConnectionBasedJmsConnectionFactory' provides methods to create and configure JMS connections based on a given Connection object, including handling SSL contexts, URI building with parameters, and failover configurations.

classes.name: ConnectionBasedJmsConnectionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating JMS connections based on a Connection object, supporting SSL, URI configuration, and failover.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ConnectionBasedJmsConnectionFactory with the provided AMQP configuration.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Creates a JMS connection based on the provided Connection, setting SSL context and exception listener.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Builds a JNDI InitialContext for the connection using the connection URI.

methods.name: buildAmqpConnectionUriFromConnection
methods.description: Constructs the AMQP connection URI with parameters, including failover and security options.

methods.name: isSecuredConnection
methods.description: Checks if the connection uses the 'amqps' protocol indicating a secured connection.

methods.name: formatUri
methods.description: Formats the URI string with protocol, hostname, and port.

methods.name: getJmsParameters
methods.description: Generates JMS-specific URI parameters, including client ID, timeouts, and credentials.

methods.name: getAmqpParameters
methods.description: Generates AMQP protocol parameters, including SASL mechanisms.

methods.name: getTransportParameters
methods.description: Generates transport layer parameters, e.g., trust settings for invalid certificates.

methods.name: getFailoverParameters
methods.description: Creates failover-related URI parameters with retry and reconnect settings.

methods.name: wrapWithFailOver
methods.description: Wraps a URI string with failover syntax.
